title: Evaluation of the bent direct product
statement: For nonnegative integers $n$ and $m$, let $f$ and $g$ be real-valued functions on the respective binary cubes, and let $x$ and $y$ be points in those cubes. The bent direct product of $f$ and $g$, evaluated at the concatenation of $x$ and $y$, equals $f(x)g(y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the binary cube of dimension $n$
$g$ is a real-valued function on the binary cube of dimension $m$
$x$ belongs to the binary cube of dimension $n$
$y$ belongs to the binary cube of dimension $m$
